input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 binds Customer to use Vendor as its sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services for the entire term, with no product-category limit, no time limit, and no performance-based exit — the playbook walk-away position. It also conflicts directly with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment. Deletion reaches the preferred position with the smallest edit and leaves 12.3 to govern; the 12-month, category-limited fallback with an SLA-failure exit is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Delete Section 2.2 exclusivity obligation making Vendor our sole and exclusive analytics provider
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted Section 2.2 because we cannot commit to a sole and exclusive supplier for hosted analytics services, and Section 12.3 already confirms we make no exclusivity commitment. If Copperleaf needs some volume comfort, we could consider exclusivity limited to a defined product category for 12 months, terminating automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.
